name: Reload
notes: Dodging while reloading cancels your reload (the clip stays as it was; with Dodge Reload Skip it finishes instead). If you are out of bullets, it will automatically start reloading again.
summary: Tactical reload: a cast that takes the whole recharge (2.0 s down to 1.2 s), then refills the clip. Refused on a full clip. Shows the same icon sweep as the automatic reload. When the clip hits 0 an automatic reload starts by itself.
